title: Prove independent idle factors cannot beat balanced path cuts (no new κ)
body:
The dominant idle invoice suggested selecting each stage factor independently inside each idle window. This package proves that the enlarged exact path-controller family cannot improve the balanced ordinary cut, for every pair count p and every concave rank price with f(0)=0.

The proof derives each stage's actual projector from the chronological source word. Pairwise commutation is equivalent to intersection of consecutive vertex intervals; those intervals force one common cut. Deleting all extra factors then prices both the lost target rank and removed paid work. A separate concavity argument makes the balanced cut optimal within the fixed query-thinned stage pattern.

**No new κ is claimed.** This is a source-bound written obstruction with finite exact controls, not a global controller ceiling or formal proof-kernel acceptance. The theorem retains the path bridges, paid query alphabet, constant scalar boundaries on the main roles, independent Laurent stage factors, and unchanged local native inventory. It does not cover changed topologies, other native/direct stage patterns, border recovery or arbitrary geometric quotients that change native directions. The formal BIT group ring with independent involutive generators is included: one-variable coefficient comparison remains valid in characteristic two. Selected κ remains 0.00302015.

Only `research/partial-idle-cut-normal-form/` is added. Start with README.md and PROOF.md. Standard-library Python validation passes: registered metadata/replay and optimized direct replay; seven actual source words; 1,023 individual stage subsets on 7,422 exact integer nodes; 26,093 projector-pair checks; all 4,728 compatible families through p=4 with capped-rank dominance; 528 balanced-cut comparisons; 128 general multistage recurrence checks at Q=2; and 36 exact canonical-boundary controls. The full selected p16 invoice is a positive control: 10,928 targets, 64,620 paid jobs and rank surplus 752. Seven actual BIT group-ring source words and the complete BIT p16 invoice also match; all 26,093 projector-pair checks pass in characteristic two. Committed-byte preflight and 14-file source export integrity pass. Source-history preflight is unavailable in the shallow checkout. No unchanged selected-native/outer cold replay or Lean build was run.

Base and refresh: canonical main `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. User-assigned κ research; the historical QQ16 card's scope change is explicit in TASK.json. This extends the minimal-cut search domain of PR4446, rather than repeating its native/direct mask scan. PR4623's border result and PR4602's idle-cost diagnosis are credited and address different interfaces. The bounded next step is a changed controller topology with an exact small Laurent factorization, or a paid chronological border recovery theorem.

Credit zxv; Cinna Davis's PR4440/4441/4447/4470 chain; Jacob Alan Sussman's mixed compiler; and retained native, Clifford, BIT, precision, stock and outer contributors. Prepared for Cinna Davis (1337isnot1337) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.
